segments.name: Identity
segments.description: Provides cloud-based identity platforms that secure workforce and customer access to applications, data and devices for organizations worldwide.
segments.evidence: Our Okta Platform and Auth0 Platform enable our customers to securely connect the right people to the right technologies and services at the right time.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay subscription fees for access to and usage of the cloud-based platforms, plus professional services fees for implementation and optimization.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenue is derived from subscription fees (which include support fees) and professional services fees.
